newsitem.title: USA: Sensormatic Q4 shr loss after charge.
newsitem.headline: Sensormatic Q4 shr loss after charge.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Fiscal Q4 1997 net includes an after-tax restructure and special charge of $34.6 million, or $0.47 per share, related to overhead reduction and rationalization of the company's retail and commercial/industrial operations in Europe and the divestiture of certain non-core businesses.
Excluding these charges, the company's Q4 1997 net loss was $800,000, or $0.01 per share.
Before restructuring and special charges, Q4 1997 operating income was $7.8 million compared with $8.7 million in the year ago quarter.
The fiscal 1997 net loss includes the fourth quarter charges. The fiscal 1996 net loss incudes an after-tax charge of $118.2 million, or $1.61 per share, due to restructuring and special charges.
Excluding restructuring and special charges for both periods, fiscal 1997 net income was $13.2 million, or $0.18 per share, as compared to $20.5 million, or $0.28 per share, for fiscal 1996.
